vectors.name: block list at the key's indentation
comments and a document start only
image with packages and setup, merged with the top level
vectors.yml:
packages: [libvips-dev]
image:
  packages: [protobuf-compiler, libvips-dev]
  setup: |
    curl -fsSL https://example.com/x.sh | sh

    echo done   # stays: block scalars keep comments

spec.setup:
curl -fsSL https://example.com/x.sh | sh

echo done   # stays: block scalars keep comments
